blurb: Guests can enjoy private or group boat tours including speedboat rides, lakefront sightseeing, sunset tours, fireworks tours, and fishing charters. Tours are customizable with options for routes, timing, and add-ons like decorations and photographers. Boats range from mid-sized cruisers to luxury yachts, all captained by licensed professionals.
